import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }

        static int modInv(int a) {
            return modInv(a, MOD);
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * other.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return mul(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt a = new ModInt(val);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result.mul(a);
                a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        ModInt inc() {
            val = (val == MOD - 1) ? 0 : val + 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt dec() {
            val = (val == 0) ? MOD - 1 : val - 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt negate() {
            return val == 0 ? new ModInt(0) : new ModInt(MOD - val);
        }

        boolean equals(ModInt other) {
            return val == other.val;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (this == obj) return true;
            if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) obj;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Integer.hashCode(val);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }

    static final int N_MAX = 7;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        Map<List<Boolean>, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        List<Boolean> starting = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            starting.add(i == 0);
        }
        possibleMasks.put(starting, new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<List<Boolean>, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt product = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    int bit = (current >> right) & 1;
                    if (bit == 1) {
                        product.mul(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        product.mul(new ModInt(1).sub(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<List<Boolean>, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                    List<Boolean> possible = entry.getKey();
                    ModInt prob = entry.getValue();
                    List<Boolean> newPossible = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
                        newPossible.add(false);
                    }

                    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
                        if (possible.get(mask)) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                                int curBit = (current >> i) & 1;
                                int maskBit = (mask >> i) & 1;
                                if (curBit == 1 && maskBit == 0) {
                                    newPossible.set(mask | (1 << i), true);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    ModInt newProb = new ModInt(prob.val);
                    newProb.mul(product);
                    newPossibleMasks.put(newPossible, addOrMerge(newPossibleMasks.get(newPossible), newProb));
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        List<Boolean> fullMask = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            fullMask.add(i == (1 << N) - 1);
        }

        for (Map.Entry<List<Boolean>, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getKey().equals(fullMask)) {
                answer = addOrMerge(answer, entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }

    static ModInt addOrMerge(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        if (a == null) return b;
        if (b == null) return a;
        ModInt result = new ModInt(a.val);
        result.add(b);
        return result;
    }
}
